pick.name: Stripe India (invite-only)
pick.why: Only if invited; not a launch dependency
pick.free_limits: Invite-only for Indian businesses; export (non-INR) payments only for registered businesses (sole proprietorship/LLP/company), NOT individuals; IEC optional for services unless AMEX intl or FTP benefits; payouts in INR; 3DS required on intl cards

alts.name: Stripe Managed Payments
alts.free_limits: Checkout/Payment Links only; no Connect; supported business countries listed on eligibility page (35+ per LS Jan 2026 post; India not included)

alts.name: Razorpay International
alts.free_limits: Intl cards up to 3% + 18% GST on fee

candidates.name: Stripe India
candidates.verdict: Status only: invite-only, needs registered business

candidates.name: Stripe Atlas US C-Corp
candidates.verdict: Route LS points unsupported countries to; adds US tax/compliance cost

decision: Do not plan on Stripe: invite-only, individuals excluded from exports. Use a MoR for global SaaS and Razorpay for INR; revisit Stripe only after forming a sole proprietorship/company and receiving an invite.

verify.note: Stripe doc: 'Stripe is available by invite only in India'; exports only for a registered sole proprietorship/LLP/company, 'can't be an individual'; IEC optional for services unless AMEX intl or FTP benefits; INR payouts; 3DS for intl cards. Managed Payments alt: the eligibility list has 35 business locations (CA, US, 29 European, AU, HK, JP, SG) and no India; it also excludes professional services (consulting/dev) and supports only Checkout/Payment Links with no Connect.
